title: Convert DR exercise evidence into maintained readiness: decision comparison 2
teachingQuestion: How does an exercise observation become a verified, owned, and retested recovery improvement?
focalInsight: Observation, evidence, finding, owner/action, plan change, retest, and truthful test status.
caption: Compare meaning, decision conditions, and failures. These concise distinctions are paired with the worked examples in the teaching unit.

nodes.label: Recovery Readiness
nodes.definition: The supported confidence that people, plans, dependencies, and capability can meet stated recovery needs.
nodes.decision: Assess readiness from objective evidence and unresolved risk, not from the existence of a plan or a single exercise.
nodes.failureExample: Declaring readiness while a key dependency remains untested creates false assurance.
